page.overview:
Who is Amir?

Amir was a man who lived in the 2010s. He was Noah Wexmore's childhood sweetheart.

Sometime in the 2010s, Amir didn't speak to Noah for two days. Unsure of what caused the rift and hoping to mend the situation, Noah placed an order at Confiserie d'André for eight dishes of Hearty Custard Pie, hoping its warmth and sweetness would be enough to bring Amir back to his side.
